correction_trigger.observed_before_v2_runs: support-only refit did not reproduce the archived migrated parent
correction_trigger.root_cause: grid.build_sampler had changed from the registered shot-first sampler to a later class-first sampler
correction_trigger.restored_contract: uniform shot draw, then within-shot positive/negative branch and endpoint draw
correction_trigger.result_dependence: v1 selected/random metrics were observed but are invalidated; v2 changes only the sampler needed to recover the sealed parent

claim_boundary: balanced360 informed architecture, query-policy and this corrective diagnosis; every result remains TEST_DRIVEN_EXPLORATION and is not independent confirmation

arms.support_only: zero-extra-label fidelity control on all 360 shots
arms.selected: front-load every archived active-query label; never score those training shots
arms.random_uniform_blocked: label-agnostic random shots matched to active per-20-shot query counts; replicates 0,1,2

common_evaluation: for selected-versus-random inference, exclude the union of both extra-training sets

thresholds.secondary: recalibrate on the unchanged EAST110 only
thresholds.forbidden: no balanced360 label may select a threshold, epoch, alarm parameter or loss weight

checks: encoder and EAST-head SHA256 exact match

fairness_boundary.temporal_query_count: random control matched within each fixed 20-shot block
fairness_boundary.frontload_compute: same migration recipe across support-only, selected and random; not FLOP-matched to historical causal online inter-updates
fairness_boundary.causal_question: selected front-load versus causal online is evaluated on a label-disjoint common complement
fairness_boundary.remaining_control: a same-gradient-step block-batch arm requires new online batch ledgers and is reported as not reconstructible from historical artifacts

primary_objective: lead-qualified TPR at 30 ms minus FPR
